description.value: Cit-E Cycles Hillside is one of six BC locations of a specialist e-bike retailer marketing itself as Canada's largest e-bike selection, stocking 195+ models from 20+ brands. The shop sits on Hillside Avenue in central Victoria with direct connections to the Galloping Goose Trail, a car-free corridor running from downtown Victoria to Sooke — making it a natural stop for e-bike touring. A full-service repair shop staffed by certified technicians handles tune-ups, diagnostics, and major repairs for all e-bike brands.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands at 23m; stands at 24m; rack at 63m; staple (2 spaces) at 88m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for citecycles.com/pages/victoria-hillside was successfully fetched and provides strong primary evidence: it confirms the OSM address, supplies a phone number absent from OSM, and explicitly describes a full-service repair operation with certified technicians covering all e-bike brands. E-bike service is doubly confirmed by the website's Service & Repairs section and the OSM tag service:bicycle:ebike=yes. No evidence was found for a floor pump, walk-in repairs (only walk-in test rides are mentioned), or most other optional amenities.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone 250-590-6967 sourced from the business website location page only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible specialist e-bike shop with confirmed address, active website, and full-service repair capability — a clear inclusion for any cycling directory.
